reader_question: Does EO 14148 end each of the 8 batch-02 orders as a whole, on what date, and does anything in it (savings, transfer, exception, delayed effect) leave part of any of them operating or move the date?

savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect: (i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof; or (ii) the functions of the Director of the Office of Management and Budget relating to budgetary, administrative, or legislative proposals.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Standard no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions. It preserves no provision, office, body or action of any revoked order.

savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: shall review all Federal Government actions taken pursuant to the orders, memoranda, and proclamations listed in section 2 of this order and take necessary steps to rescind, replace, or amend such actions as appropriate
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Review-and-rescind direction to the DPC and NEC Directors. It shows agency actions already taken under a listed order are not themselves voided by the revocation, but it is not a savings clause: it keeps no clause, office or right of any listed order operating.

savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: To effectuate the revocations described in section 2 of this order, the heads of each agency shall take immediate steps to end Federal implementation of unlawful and radical DEI ideology.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Implementation direction to end DEI implementation; it confirms the revocations are meant to take effect at once and adds no delay.

transfer_phrase_note: The packet's two transfer-phrase hits are the words 'Succession' in the titles of EO 14134-14139 (sec. 2(jjj)-(ooo)); they are revoked orders of succession, not transfers of any batch-02 target's functions.
effective_date_reading: Sec. 2 says 'The following executive actions are hereby revoked'. Secs. 1-4 contain no effective-date, delayed-effect, phase-in or conditional wording (read in full, 16,084 characters; PDF pages 1-5). Each revocation therefore took effect on signing, January 20, 2025 (printed 90 FR 8237-8241, January 28, 2025).
target_exception_check: None of the eight falls in an exception: each is named by number, date and title in a plain sec. 2 sentence with no 'except', 'to the extent', 'as amended' or 'in part' wording, and no later subsection narrows sec. 2. EO 14143 (signed 2025-01-16, four days earlier) and EO 14124 (2024-07-17) are listed like the rest.
conclusion: EO 14148 (signed 2025-01-20, 90 FR 8237-8241, PDF pages 1-5), read once in full, revokes 78 listed executive actions in sec. 2(a)-(zzz), among them EO 13985 (a), 13999 (l), 14006 (q), 14019 (aa), 14035 (jj), 14052 (pp), 14124 (iii) and 14143 (zzz). It has no effective-date wording, so each revocation is effective on signing, 2025-01-20. Sec. 3 directs agencies to end implementation, tells the DPC and NEC Directors to review and rescind actions taken under the listed orders and to propose more rescissions within 45 days, and tells the NSA to review NSMs. Sec. 4 is a general no-impair clause for statutory authority and OMB functions plus a no-private-rights clause. There is no successor delegation, no transfer of functions, funds or property, no pending-matter clause and no exception for any listed order. Whether a revoked order leaves a residual of its own (completed revocations or supersessions of other orders, delegations, accrued status) therefore depends on the order read, not on EO 14148. EO 14148 does not say whether its revocations revive anything the listed orders had revoked or superseded.
